scope: 206 个主款 × 7 个在售场景（6 大户外 + 企业礼赠）
policy_zh: 场景为选型建议，不代表适用性测试、认证或性能证明；下单前需核对所选配置、用途与型号说明。
policy_en: Selection suggestions only — not a suitability test, certification or performance claim. Confirm the chosen configuration and intended use before ordering.

CAR.confirm_zh: 核对场地容器规定、单杯份量与车载携带方式。
CAR.confirm_en: Check venue container rules, pour size and how it travels in the car.

BEACH.confirm_zh: 核对场地禁玻璃规定、风沙环境与清洗方式。
BEACH.confirm_en: Check the venue's no-glass rule, wind and sand exposure, and how it gets washed.

CAMP.confirm_zh: 核对收纳体积、背包空间与煮沸饮品的使用温度。
CAMP.confirm_en: Check packed size, pack space and the temperature of hot drinks.

BBQ.confirm_zh: 核对长桌摆位、多人轮次与清洗条件。
BBQ.confirm_en: Check table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions.

YACHT.confirm_zh: 核对甲板防滑、杯型稳定与船方容器规定。
YACHT.confirm_en: Check deck grip, how stable the shape is and the operator's container rules.

BAR.confirm_zh: 核对出杯速度、叠放收纳与夜间照明条件。
BAR.confirm_en: Check service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark.

CORP.confirm_zh: 核对 logo 印面、套装组成与包装方式。
CORP.confirm_en: Check the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed.

scenes.reason_zh: PP工具件，吧台操作设计。一个班次用上百次，握感和清洗都按商用做。
scenes.reason_en: A PP bar tool built for service: Used a hundred times a shift, so grip and washing are built for it.
scenes.use_zh: 一个班次用上百次，握感和清洗都按商用做。
scenes.use_en: Used a hundred times a shift, so grip and washing are built for it.

scenes.reason_zh: PP工具件，吧台操作设计。印上 logo 送给调酒爱好者，使用频率比摆件高。
scenes.reason_en: A PP bar tool built for service: Logo it for home bartenders and it gets used, not shelved.
scenes.use_zh: 印上 logo 送给调酒爱好者，使用频率比摆件高。
scenes.use_en: Logo it for home bartenders and it gets used, not shelved.

scenes.reason_zh: PP桶身，可装冰与整瓶酒。冰块和啤酒一起放桌上，客人自己拿，主人不用一直添。
scenes.reason_en: A PP bucket sized for ice and bottles: Ice and bottles on the table together so guests serve themselves.
scenes.use_zh: 冰块和啤酒一起放桌上，客人自己拿，主人不用一直添。
scenes.use_en: Ice and bottles on the table together so guests serve themselves.

scenes.reason_zh: PP桶身，可装冰与整瓶酒。吧台后面一桶冰镇着，出杯时直接取。
scenes.reason_en: A PP bucket sized for ice and bottles: One bucket chilling behind the bar, bottles pulled straight out.
scenes.use_zh: 吧台后面一桶冰镇着，出杯时直接取。
scenes.use_en: One bucket chilling behind the bar, bottles pulled straight out.

scenes.reason_zh: PP桶身，可装冰与整瓶酒。香槟和冰块一起端上甲板，桶底放得住，晃船也不洒。
scenes.reason_en: A PP bucket sized for ice and bottles: Champagne and ice carried up together, steady on a moving deck.
scenes.use_zh: 香槟和冰块一起端上甲板，桶底放得住，晃船也不洒。
scenes.use_en: Champagne and ice carried up together, steady on a moving deck.

scenes.reason_zh: PS制冰/取冰件。服务点配齐取冰的一套，出杯不用停。
scenes.reason_en: A PS ice tool: The whole ice station in one place, so service never stops.
scenes.use_zh: 服务点配齐取冰的一套，出杯不用停。
scenes.use_en: The whole ice station in one place, so service never stops.

scenes.reason_zh: PS制冰/取冰件。院子里的冰箱和冰桶之间来回用，取冰不脏手。
scenes.reason_en: A PS ice tool: Moves between the garage freezer and the cooler without wet hands.
scenes.use_zh: 院子里的冰箱和冰桶之间来回用，取冰不脏手。

scenes.reason_zh: PS制冰/取冰件。冰铲带沥水孔，冰化得慢，杯子不泡在水里。
scenes.reason_en: A PS ice tool: A slotted scoop drains meltwater instead of pooling it in the cup.
scenes.use_zh: 冰铲带沥水孔，冰化得慢，杯子不泡在水里。

scenes.reason_zh: PS制冰/取冰件。制冰和造型冰提前备好，客人到了直接上。
scenes.reason_en: A PS ice tool: Shape the ice ahead and it is ready when guests arrive.
scenes.use_zh: 制冰和造型冰提前备好，客人到了直接上。
scenes.use_en: Shape the ice ahead and it is ready when guests arrive.
